items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And that's how it was during my first recording here in the U.S. with the orquestra of Machito and his Afro-Cubans.

ctx.x: And how long did it last?

One hour. Then they . . . I said to them, "I would like to accompany the orchestra during that radio hour." They said, "Yes of course, you can, with pleasure." They had their rhythm (section). The conga player was Carlos Vidal and the bongo player was Mangual. Jose Mangual. The timbale player was Ubaldo Nieto. That was the rhythm. Rene Hernandez on piano, the bass was Julio Andino. That was the rhythm section. Then I asked them, "I would like to accompany the radio broadcast and play Tanga, and they said, “Yes,…
Who decided whether to re-record certain numbers because they did not meet the requirements of good sound recording? Whose whims were followed?
